columns.name: customernumber
columns.description: Unique identifier for the customer.

columns.name: customername
columns.description: Name of the customer.

columns.name: country
columns.description: Country where the customer is located.

columns.name: has_credit_limit_not_more_than_100000
columns.description: Set to 1 if the credit limit of the customer is not more than $100,000; otherwise, set to 0.

columns.name: total_payments_2003
columns.description: Total payments made by the customer in 2003, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: has_paid_more_than_three_times_in_2003
columns.description: Set to 1 if the customer has made more than three payments in 2003; otherwise, set to 0.

columns.name: total_actual_profit_gained
columns.description: Total actual profit gained from the customer, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: total_price_of_product_shipped_in_2003
columns.description: Total price of products shipped to the customer in 2003, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: employeenumber
columns.description: Unique identifier for the employee.

columns.name: officecode
columns.description: Office code where the employee is located.

columns.name: name
columns.description: The name of the employee, formed by concatenating the first name and last name with a space in between.

columns.name: number_of_customers
columns.description: Number of customers the employee is responsible for, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: is_in_Sydney
columns.description: Set to 1 if the employee is located in Sydney; otherwise, set to 0.

columns.name: product_name_of_the_highest_amount_of_order
columns.description: Name of the product with the highest total amount paid across all orders handled by the employee; with ties broken by the ascending order of the product name.

columns.name: customer_made_highest_payment
columns.description: Name of the customer who made the highest total payment to the employee, with ties broken by the descending order of the customer name.

columns.name: highest_customer_credit_limit
columns.description: The highest credit limit among the customers the employee is responsible for.

columns.name: productcode
columns.description: Unique identifier for the product.

columns.name: productname
columns.description: Name of the product.

columns.name: buyprice
columns.description: Price at which the product is bought.

columns.name: number_of_product_ordered
columns.description: Number of the product has been ordered, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: expected_profit_per_piece
columns.description: Expected profit per piece of the product.

columns.name: num_of_customers
columns.description: Number of customers who have ordered the product, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: total_quantity_sold_in_2003
columns.description: Total quantity of the product sold in 2003, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: average_actual_profit
columns.description: Average actual profit per unit sold for the product.
